message.reasoning:
Key issue: "geostationary orbit at an altitude of 600 km" — technically wrong (LEO). Also no explicit software selection statement? STK mentioned. Preliminary technical work: STK tutorials only, weak. Mission concept good with references. Plan has Gantt chart. Presentation decent but short, references as bare URLs.

C1: Accomplished ~8. C2: Adequate 6 (plan lacks contingency detail; also technical error in orbit). C3: Adequate 4-5 (tutorials, no results). C4: Adequate 5-6 (clear structure, but references as URLs, short).
